items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Talking about trumpet, do you remember Buddy Petit? Buddy Petit, yeah, I know him good, too.

ctx.x: Oh man, I don't know. Well he used to use Peter Boccage, Richard Payne, Bonk, either Buddy or Yannick, I can't remember which. It must have been Buddy. I think Buddy was a better reader than Yannick.

Yeah, well I don't know, but Buddy and Yannick, poor for some one player. Yeah. Yeah. And Walter Brundy, I think you used. Walter Brundy was a drummer. Yeah. He worked with Roebeshaw for a long, long time. All the time I knew him used to work with John Roebeshaw.
Billy had the, Billy Moreira had the Superior. Yeah. Yeah, that's right.
